name: UGC 3860 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 3860, a nearby galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc3860-hubble
story: Hubble measured the brightness of this galaxy's individual stars to find how far away it is, adding a point to a three-dimensional map of the galaxies around us.

claims.text: UGC 3860 is a target of Hubble program 13442, The Geometry and Kinematics of the Local Volume
The program measures distances to nearby galaxies from the luminosities of their stars
The distances are used to build three-dimensional maps of galaxies
